mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the broader economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 10-year average, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1 percentage points, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high GDP growth and strong consumer confidence, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal continued demand for residential construction and associated economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from the previous month, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate output, which lowers earnings expectations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of the broader economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.3% from the previous month, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow at a rate exceeding 1.0% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% MoM, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary policy response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market slowdown regime, a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals weakening economic momentum and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle labor market slowdowns when PAYEMS declines by at least 0.3% MoM, or the Rank IC over 5 years is less than 0.02.
